title: dactylorhiza fuchsii subsp. carpatica
intro: Dactylorhiza fuchsii subsp. carpatica, commonly known as the Alpine Spotted Orchid, is a subspecies of the Spotted Orchid plant, native to the mountainous regions of Central and Eastern Europe. The Alpine Spotted Orchid has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. It is valued for its therapeutic actions, such as promoting wound healing, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of the Alpine Spotted Orchid include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
